Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call:

- Goal: reduce per-query inference cost and get predictable p99 latency for customer-facing search/qa features.
- Current stack: in-house transformer serving on mixed CPU/GPU; peak latency hits during morning traffic spikes.
- What matters: predictable tail latency, auditability for data residency, and cost per 1M tokens.

Next steps we agreed on:
1) I put together a short quote and a baseline perf/cost estimate for your workload (attached).
2) Rishi to share a short runbook for a 2-week POC (dedicated pool, sample traffic).
3) Align procurement on pricing/term questions  CCing Avery for procurement sync.

Attached: redwood-quote-20260601.pdf (high-level sizing + pricing).

Thanks  talk soon.
